card.name: Small words in overdose and treatment instructions
card.fires_on: Small linking words like a, is, and, soon inside treatment or overdose instructions in drug labels. Also odd spots partway through a drug name.

modes.label: Article before a help or setting noun
modes.description: The word a just before circumstance, Poison Control Center, or pretreatment in overdose or antidote text.
modes.example: In case of accidental overdose, seek professional assistance or contact<< a>> Poison Control Center immediately.

modes.label: Linking word in treatment course
modes.description: Words like soon, is, or and in sentences about completing therapy or finding an antidote.
modes.example: No specific antidote for omeprazole overdosage<< is>> known.

modes.label: Inside a drug name
modes.description: A piece in the middle of a drug name such as hydroxocobalamin or acetylcysteine.
modes.example: through the same intravenous line as hydro<<x>>ocobalamin.

card.writes: It lowers the odds of severity and symptom words next, so the text is less likely to go on to describe how bad something is.
card.plain: It fires on little connecting words in overdose and treatment sentences of drug labels.
